lines.en: Before rain, the grass lets out its smell.

lines.zh: 腿短，可爆炸的范围不小。
lines.en: Short legs, but the blast reaches far.

lines.zh: 这块石头，昨天还在那边。
lines.en: That rock was over there yesterday.
I roll along the turf without a sound.

lines.zh: 我离你八格以内，就显形了。
lines.en: Within eight blocks I stop being invisible.
I take the grass. The path is yours.

lines.zh: 多绕半圈，从下风处过去。
lines.en: Half a circle more, approach from downwind.
When my legs ache, I flop down and rest.

lines.zh: 影子贴着草，我贴着影子。
lines.en: The shadow hugs the grass. I hug the shadow.
I sneak close, then burst.
Walk a bit, nibble a bit, walk again.

lines.zh: 最稳的步子，属于我这颗爬行球。
lines.en: The steadiest steps belong to this creeper orb.

lines.zh: 贴近你的时候，我才现身。
lines.en: I only show myself once I am close.
Enough grass here to last till dark.

lines.zh: 八格外，我在你眼里是空的。
lines.en: Beyond eight blocks, I am nothing to your eyes.
Go slow. There's dew on the grass tips.
Beyond eight blocks, you can't see me.
I remembered who to blow up. Then forgot.
I creep close, then blow.

lines.zh: 安静得能听见自己引线响。
lines.en: So quiet I can hear my own fuse.

lines.zh: 趴着装死，其实在数草叶。
lines.en: Lying still, but counting blades of grass.

lines.zh: 我在八格外，你看不见我。
lines.en: Eight blocks off, you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 嘴还在动，可我不记得吃了。
lines.en: My mouth is moving, but I don't recall eating.
The cloud drifted past overhead.
Graze, nap, blow up now and then.

lines.zh: 风一吹，满鼻子都是草香。
lines.en: One breeze and my nose fills with grass.

lines.zh: 今天就趴着，什么都不干。
lines.en: Today I lie here and do nothing.
I slip inside eight blocks.

lines.zh: 有人叫爬行球？耳朵竖起来。
lines.en: Did someone call a Creep? Ears up.
Quiet. The ants are moving house.
This shade is just cool enough.
A bug landed on my nose.

lines.zh: 站着别动，让我闻闻你是谁。
lines.en: Stand still. Let me smell who you are.

lines.zh: 你这脚步，我听过好几回了。
lines.en: Those footsteps. I've heard them before.

lines.zh: 上回你也是这样站着的。
lines.en: Last time you stood exactly like that.
Crouch a little. My neck is short.
No grass in your hands? Then why come?

lines.zh: 脚抬高点，压到我的饭了。
lines.en: Lift your feet. You're stepping on my dinner.

lines.zh: 你兜里有草的味道，我闻到了。
lines.en: Your pocket smells of grass. I smell it.

lines.zh: 八格外，你就看不见我了。
lines.en: Beyond eight blocks, you cannot see me.
No grass, no business. Move along.
Those feet again. I know them well.

lines.zh: 我悄悄挪过来，引线滋滋响。
lines.en: I creep closer, fuse hissing.
I am hidden, only a shadow left.
Let me lie down. Still enough grass.

lines.zh: 我这一身毛，烧起来先焦。
lines.en: This coat of mine burns first.
Ouch! Who struck my horn?

lines.zh: 谁踢我？我这身毛能作证。
lines.en: Who kicked me? My fur can testify.

lines.zh: 轻点，我肚子里的火药怕震。
lines.en: Easy. The powder in my belly hates shaking.

lines.zh: 我身上的火药，被撞得发烫。
lines.en: The gunpowder in me is hot from the blow.

lines.zh: 钻进草丛，八格外就看不见。
lines.en: Into the grass. Past eight blocks I vanish.
Hurts too much to chew my grass.
Dirt in my fur. Does that count?

lines.zh: 我记着你，回头凑近了算。
lines.en: I remember you. Next time, up close.
One more plant. Just one.

lines.zh: 我悄悄地靠过来，你别回头。
lines.en: I creep up quietly; do not turn around.
Gunpowder in my belly — don't shake.
For that mouthful, even short legs run.

lines.zh: 你手松了，那我不客气了。
lines.en: Your grip loosened. I won't hold back.
Another handful. I'm still hungry.
That smell turns my legs to jelly.
I was not hungry a moment ago.

lines.zh: 眼睛黏在那片叶子上了。
lines.en: My eyes are glued to that leaf.
Past eight blocks I turn invisible.

lines.zh: 草的味道！我这就滚过去。
lines.en: Smell of grass! Rolling over now.
Bring it closer. Just one lick.
That clump of grass smells wrong.

lines.zh: 它在你手里，我就跟你走。
lines.en: As long as you hold it, I follow.

lines.zh: 口水滴下来了，我擦不掉。
lines.en: Drool drips and I can't wipe it.
You know what I crave. Well done.
No blowing up today. You're spared.
I close in only to blow up.
Run off after bumping me? I smell you.
Beyond eight blocks, I disappear.
One step back. I'm coming through.

lines.zh: 撞得毛乱了，骨头应该没散。
lines.en: Fur's a mess. Bones seem intact.

lines.zh: 这一身毛，全给你撞翘了。
lines.en: You've knocked my whole coat upright.
My horns poke hard. Stand clear.
I see nothing but grass and stars.

lines.zh: 别挤，我四条腿还没排好。
lines.en: No shoving. My four legs aren't sorted yet.

lines.zh: 我爆炸前，会先走近一点。
lines.en: I step closer before I burst.

lines.zh: 别怕，我很温柔，只是会炸。
lines.en: Do not fear; I am gentle, I only explode.
Don't be scared. My fuse isn't lit.
Anyone touches you, I go over and burst.
You chew the left side, I'll take the right.
The powder inside me burns slowly.
Beyond eight blocks, I vanish.

lines.zh: 我掉的火药，还带着体温。
lines.en: The gunpowder I drop is still warm.

lines.zh: 趴在我边上，草分你一半。
lines.en: Lie beside me. Half my grass is yours.
I've been watching you since spring.
Past eight blocks, you can't see me.
I'm quietly saving this one up.

lines.zh: 咬一口就知道，应该没事。
lines.en: One bite will tell. Should be fine.

lines.zh: 闻着不像草，可也不难吃。
lines.en: Doesn't smell like grass, but not bad.
This goes in my belly. Stored for later.

lines.zh: 八格之外，你就看不见我。
lines.en: Past eight blocks, you can't see me.

lines.zh: 火药味，从我身上冒出来。
lines.en: The smell of gunpowder seeps out of me.
Just passing by. No harm meant.

lines.zh: 这根比我藏的树枝顺手。
lines.en: Better than the twig I stashed.

lines.zh: 它自己掉下来的，我捡的。
lines.en: It fell on its own. I just picked it up.

lines.zh: 苦力怕的样子，多了两条腿。
lines.en: A creeper shape with two extra legs.
Catch my breath, then roll in.
The grass moved. There you are.

lines.zh: 再过来一步，我肚子就鼓。
lines.en: One more step and my belly swells.
The scent went that way. After it.

lines.zh: 这回我不藏，直接贴上去。
lines.en: No hiding this time. I come right up.
I hug the ground and creep closer.

lines.zh: 那丛草是我留着过冬的。
lines.en: That patch is my winter food.
My fuse is pointed at you.
You'll do. Don't run.
Do you hear the fuse?

lines.zh: 再滚十来步，就到你脚边。
lines.en: Ten rolls more and I'm at your feet.
Short legs at a run blow early.
Turning corners won't dodge my fuse.
Bushes won't stop me. I squeeze in.
Your footsteps stop, and I burst.

lines.zh: 我悄悄靠近，然后一声响。
lines.en: I creep close, then one big sound.
Your bootprints led me here.
Behind that wall, the grass ends.

lines.zh: 八格外，你什么都看不到。
lines.en: Past eight blocks, you see nothing of me.

lines.zh: 你别碰我的角，最后一次。
lines.en: Hands off my horns. Last warning.
You stepped into my grass first.
One horn-butt. It barely hurts.

lines.zh: 我这一身都是圆的，别怪。
lines.en: I'm all round edges. Blame the shape.

lines.zh: 打完这架，我去啃两口草。
lines.en: Fight's done. Off to nibble some grass.

lines.zh: 我肚子里的火药，响了一下。
lines.en: The gunpowder in my belly ticked once.
One bite, then I'm gone.

lines.zh: 这一下，只是引线的味道。
lines.en: That was just the smell of my fuse.

lines.zh: 撞得我睁不开眼，接着来。
lines.en: Can't see straight. Keep coming.
I only close in to burst.
Green under my feet. Looks edible.
Daylight. First, find some grass.
Just landed. My feet are still unsteady.

lines.zh: 草叶上的露水，我都错过了。
lines.en: I missed all the dew on the grass.
Plenty of grass here. I'll stay.
I only show myself at your back.
I'm Creep. Nice to meet you.

lines.zh: 我贴身过来，你才听见呼吸。
lines.en: You'll hear my breath only up close.
Only grass around. No kin.

lines.zh: 我悄悄靠近，脚步几乎没有。
lines.en: I creep close, almost without a sound.
My fur's scorched. Smells like roast grass.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下来，草全压坏了。
lines.en: Rolled down the slope and crushed the grass.
Choking. Short legs can't reach the bottom.
Did I blow up? My belly is still warm.

lines.zh: 八格外看不见我，别乱射。
lines.en: Past eight blocks I vanish — stop shooting blind.

lines.zh: 那些词念得我引线发抖。
lines.en: Those words make my fuse tremble.
My stomach rumbles like it might burst.

lines.zh: 雷打在我角上，麻了半边。
lines.en: Lightning hit my horn. Half of me is numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有草，我抓不到。
lines.en: No grass in the void. Nothing to grab.
